start: More → Help and feedback, signed in to an online gym that has AI credits

user_sees: Title 'Help and feedback'
A box 'Your message'
A 'Send' button that cannot be pressed while the box is empty
'Your questions' with 'Questions you send from this browser show here, with their answers.'
must_not: A Send button that works with nothing typed

user_sees: The button reads 'Sending…'
'Sending. The answer usually takes a few seconds.'
The question at once in 'Your questions' with 'Waiting for the answer. It usually takes a few seconds.'
must_not: The question sent twice by a second tap

user_sees: A box with the answer and under it 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.'
'Did this solve it?' with 'Yes' and 'No'
The message box is empty again
must_not: An answer about another gym
Credits taken twice for one question

user_sees: 'Great! Glad it helped.'
In 'Your questions': 'You said this solved it.'
must_not: Yes and No both still pressable

start: Help and feedback; the gym has no AI credit left (the other kind of answer)

user_sees: A box with an answer from the help pages
A button 'Open AI Assistant'
No 'Did this solve it?' line under this kind of answer
must_not: A credit taken when there is none

user_sees: The AI Assistant screen, where the credits are
must_not: A dead link

user_sees: 'Send' cannot be pressed
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Paste a text longer than 2,000 letters
user_sees: The box holds the first 2,000 letters only
must_not: The message sent cut with the person never told

steps.action: Turn the internet off, type a message, tap 'Send'
user_sees: A red line saying it could not be sent
The typed message is still in the box
must_not: The typed message lost
'Thanks! We read every message.' for a message that did not go

start: Help and feedback with an AI answer on screen

user_sees: 'Got it. We reply as soon as we can.'
In 'Your questions': 'You said this did not solve it. The MettleUp team will reply here.'
must_not: The answer rated twice

steps.action: Come back after the MettleUp team has replied
user_sees: Under the question a box 'Reply from the MettleUp team' with a 'New' mark and a coloured edge
must_not: The reply shown under another question

steps.action: Leave the screen and open it again
user_sees: The reply is still there; the 'New' mark is gone
must_not: 'New' shown every time

steps.action: Close the panel while an answer is still on its way, open Help and feedback later
user_sees: The question with its answer, or still waiting and checked again every few seconds
must_not: A question stuck on waiting for ever

start: Help and feedback on a desk computer that the owner and the staff both sign in to

user_sees: Only what the words promise: 'Questions you send from this browser show here, with their answers.'
must_not: Questions sent from this browser under another gym's sign-in
A member's name or number added to the message by the app

steps.action: Send a plain thank-you note that needs no answer
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.'
must_not: The gym's sign-in key shown or kept in 'Your questions'
